# Error codes

Only responses the gateway produces itself use these. An upstream's own response is passed on untouched. A response from the gateway carries `X-Apg-Error: <code>`, so a client or a log query can tell the two apart.

```json
{ "error": { "code": "RATE_LIMITED", "message": "rate limit exceeded", "request_id": "…" } }
```

The body can be replaced per code, for a route or for every route, with `error_responses`.

## The gateway (node)

| Status | Code | Message |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | the request has no Host; the request path is not valid |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` | authentication is required; the credential presented is not valid |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | this consumer is not allowed here |
| 403 | `IP_FORBIDDEN` | this client address is not allowed |
| 403 | `WORKSPACE_SUSPENDED` | this workspace is suspended |
| 404 | `NO_ROUTE` | no route matches this request |
| 413 | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | the request body is larger than this route accepts |
| 429 | `BANDWIDTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | bandwidth limit exceeded |
| 429 | `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | the quota for this period is used up |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | `PLUGIN_ERROR` | a plugin that guards this route could not run; a service this route depends on could not be asked |
| 502 | `UPSTREAM_ERROR` | the upstream could not be reached or answered invalidly |
| 503 | `AUTH_UNAVAILABLE` | authentication is temporarily unavailable |
| 503 | `NO_HEALTHY_BACKEND` | no upstream is available for this route |
| 504 | `UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT` | the upstream did not answer in time |

## The Admin API

| Status | Code | When |
|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed. |
| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` | No credential, or one that is not valid. |
| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | The caller's role does not allow this. |
| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | No such resource, or it is in a workspace outside the caller's scope. |
| 409 | `CONFLICT` | The name or a unique value is taken. |
| 409 | `IN_USE` | Something else refers to the resource; delete that first or pass `cascade=true`. |
| 410 | `RESYNC_REQUIRED` | A node asked for changes that are no longer kept; it must take a snapshot. |
| 412 | `REVISION_CONFLICT` | `If-Match` did not match: someone changed the resource first. |
| 422 | `EGRESS_NOT_ALLOWED` | A backend or a callout address is private, and the caller may not point the gateway there. |
| 422 | `HOST_NOT_OWNED` | A route names a host that no active domain of the workspace covers. |
| 422 | `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | The workspace is at its limit for this kind of resource. |
| 422 | `VALIDATION_FAILED` | The resource is not valid; `details` says where. |
| 429 | `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests from this caller. |
| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | A fault in the control plane; the log has the detail under the request id. |
| 503 | `UNAVAILABLE` | Something the endpoint needs is not configured or not answering. |
